notes.title: 202208.29 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, after this update, "Search" has entered the official release version. The developer does not recommend using the EA stage archive to play, because it will lead to unpredictable errors. Subsequent updates will continue to fix some discovered problems and add new game content.
Thank you for your support since the EA stage, thank you very much

Here's what's in this update:

1. The character visual material has been replaced

2. Increase the visual effect

3. Added 3 physical skills

4. Fix some found problems

5. Map function

tags.feature: 1. The character visual material has been replaced
2. Increase the visual effect
3. Added 3 physical skills
5. Map function
